asset_label: photovoltaic module in an infrared (thermographic) image
source_note: IEC TS 62446-3:2017 Classes of Abnormality and Annex C thermal patterns with delta-T bands, as documented in docs/research/05_damage_grading_standards.md and 01_competitors_wind_solar.md. A valid thermal grade needs irradiance of at least 600 W/m2 in the module plane; when irradiance_wm2 is unknown, thermal delta-T criteria are not_measurable and the grade is based on pattern only with reduced confidence.

rows.criterion: No abnormality; module uniform in temperature relative to neighbours.
Single cell warmer than the module by 10 to 40 K.
Single cell warmer than the module by more than 40 K.
Whole module or a substring (one bypass-diode section) warmer by 2 to 7 K in a uniform pattern.
Broken front glass with irregular thermal pattern, delta-T 0 to 7 K; safety relevant regardless of temperature.

rows.pattern: hot spot with burn marks or exposed conductors
rows.criterion: Localised hot spot with visible burn marks, melted encapsulant or exposed conductor; safety relevant.
Temperature pattern explained by external shading, soiling or vegetation rather than a module defect; note as maintenance item.
A whole string or group of modules uniformly warmer than neighbours consistent with an open circuit upstream.

measurement_note: delta_t_k must be null unless the image is radiometric and irradiance is known. On 8-bit thermal crops without temperature data, grade by pattern, set not_measurable, and keep confidence at or below 0.6.

flags.not_measurable: set when delta-T cannot be measured
